e: to us |srcloc="WLC:ZEC.1.6.19" \w* \w according to our ways
And you are to tell him
But I scattered them with a whirlwind
so that no one could come
as I did in the past
because of those who march to and fro
and they will put the horsemen
and they will be as numerous
with |srcloc="WLC:ZEC.11.8.9" \w* the flock, \w and their souls
I was purchased as a servant
but Jerusalem will be raised up
